purpose: Freeze the clean point-in-time materialization boundary before any V47 NOCAP/CAP1000_PIT strategy outcome is computed.

materialization_rules.membership: Use point-in-time JPX domestic common-stock membership for each signal date; do not fall back to the 2026-09-11 current-listed 3700-symbol snapshot.
materialization_rules.daily: Use coverage-audited historical daily data for every PIT member needed by the requested windows, including restored/delisted names. Report requested, usable, failed and missing symbol/date coverage before scoring.
materialization_rules.intraday: Use causal Yahoo raw clock-bin data with a frozen coverage receipt. Report requested, usable, failed and missing symbol/date coverage before scoring.
materialization_rules.split_semantics: Absolute nominal price fields use point-in-time split factors from the accepted V46 event set. Relative/technical price features may use causal split-normalized series.
materialization_rules.absolute_features: log_price and any absolute-price feature must use point-in-time nominal price. No present-basis adjusted absolute price is permitted.
materialization_rules.prior_volume: Historical prior completed-day volume >= 10000 shares; do not silently rescale volume from future split information.
materialization_rules.cross_sectional: Recompute ranks, breadth, market medians and candidate counts independently from the clean PIT-eligible universe. Do not reuse V43/V44 current-universe cross-sectional values.
materialization_rules.target: Canonical next official XTKS open after signal date -> fifth official XTKS-session close.
materialization_rules.architecture: Exact frozen V11 3-head architecture and selector threshold 0.95; primary ATR gate none.

price_policy_arms.CAP1000_PIT: Point-in-time nominal prior completed-day close <= JPY 1000.

coverage_fail_closed: Do not compute or inspect strategy/model outcomes until PIT membership, daily, intraday and split-materialization receipts are written.
Missing restored/delisted-name data must be reported explicitly; do not silently intersect back to current survivors.
Do not choose a missing-data threshold from returns.
If missing-data coverage can materially select a survivor subset, stop before performance interpretation.
prohibited: No post-hoc deletion of V43/V44 selected rows as a substitute for clean rebuild.
No JPY500/1500/2000 or other initial price-cap grid.
No old ATR 2.864 gate in the primary comparison.
No 2026 return use for threshold, price policy, ATR or family selection.
next_action: Implement an outcome-blind V47 materializer/coverage receipt that first resolves PIT membership plus restored/delisted daily and intraday coverage, then emits clean candidate inputs for exactly NOCAP and CAP1000_PIT. Strategy scoring remains a later step after the coverage receipt passes.
